question: Who wrote the novel 'The White Tiger'?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Aravind Adiga.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **The White Tiger**

 
 
• It is a novel by Indian author Aravind Adiga.
 
• It was published in **2008 **and won the **40th Man Prize.**
 
• It provides a darkly humorous perspective of India's class struggle in a globalized world as told through a retrospective narration from Balram Halwai, a village boy.
